functionality.rationale: Incorrect coverage, graph, or approval validation could admit an unplanned task or reject a valid delivery plan.

security.rationale: Planning files are repository-controlled input, but fail-open parsing could bypass contract-first security ordering.

performance.rationale: Repository validation must remain bounded as plans and tasks grow.

compatibility.rationale: The new planning contract must preserve XT-001 through XT-063 while making plan binding mandatory for later tasks.

concurrency.rationale: Claim-time validation must not permit parallel ownership before plan approval.

platform.rationale: The standard-library validator and task generator must behave consistently on supported developer and CI platforms.

persistence.rationale: Delivery Plan schema version 1 becomes durable reviewed planning data and must reject partial or inconsistent documents.

adr.rationale: Delivery Plan schema and claim eligibility are durable cross-workstream governance contracts.

architecture.rationale: The task changes engineering governance and does not alter runtime module boundaries or dependency direction.

roadmap.rationale: XT-064 will migrate P1 roadmap decomposition after the planning contract is accepted; this task must not change product milestone status.
